description: Converts an amount from one currency to another using the latest rate, or the rate on a past date if 'date' is given. Returns the rate used, the given amount, and the converted amount. Starter plan and above (any paid plan).

amount.description: Amount to convert. Must be greater than 0. Default is 1.0.

date.description: Optional past date (YYYY-MM-DD) to convert at that day's rate instead of the latest rate.

from.description: Currency code to convert from, e.g. 'USD'.

to.description: Currency code to convert to, e.g. 'EUR'.

name: convert_currency
title: Convert an amount between currencies
